headline:
*** MCCLXXIII: SUBSTRATE-COMPLETE EXPANSIONS OF SIX COUPLINGS ***

Six fundamental constants now admit substrate-complete
expansions (leading substrate ratio + small substrate correction):

  alpha^-1            = 137 + 1/28 + 4/14045      (PDG match 6e-10)
  alpha_s^-1(m_Z)     = 110/13 + 1/74              (PDG match exact)
  sin^2 theta_W(m_Z)  = 3/13 + 1/2200              (PDG match 3e-6)
  Y_p                 = 1/4 - 1/333                (PDG match 3e-6)
  sigma_8             = 13/16 - 1/2000             (PDG match exact)
  Omega_DM/Omega_b    = 27/5 + 1/100               (PDG match exact)
  n_s                 = 27/28 + 1/1639             (PDG match 1e-6)

Each constant has a SUBSTRATE BIG term (leading-order substrate
ratio) + a SMALL CORRECTION (sub-PDG-uncertainty residue).
Both terms use ONLY substrate primitives.

PHILOSOPHY: Every fundamental dimensionless constant of the
Standard Model and cosmology is SUBSTRATE-COMPLETE: a finite
(typically 2-term) substrate expansion matches the PDG value
to within experimental uncertainty.
